name: week
title: Packaging week
subtitle: Recorded movements and unresolved returns. Fictional demo until replaced.

sections.title: Returns to chase
sections.sql: select reference,partner,item,outstanding,due_on,state from packaging.returns_due order by due_on nulls first,reference

sections.title: Disputes
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on from packaging.disputes where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence and count checks
sections.sql: select * from packaging.compliance order by rule,record

name: balances
title: Packaging balances
subtitle: Units by location and packaging type. System opening sources excluded.

sections.title: Balances
sections.sql: select location,item,quantity,last_movement from packaging.balances where kind<>'system' order by location,item

sections.title: Physical counts
sections.sql: select location,item,counted_on,counted,ledger_now_for_date,variance,backdated_change from packaging.reconciliations order by location,item

sections.title: Food-contact packaging observations
sections.note: An observation is not a release certificate. The 30-day interval is a local review policy.
sections.sql: select location,item,quantity,checked_on,state from packaging.hygiene order by location,item
